title: Player explores the crypt room; GM narrates and the goblin sentry reacts

Goblin.personality_traits: Cowardly but vicious in a pack
Goblin.combat_style: Hits and runs; flees when outnumbered

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I step into the room and look around.

actions.text: Mouldering niches line the walls. Something small shifts behind the sarcophagus.
Who goes there?! This is OUR turf!
